desc: Implement a Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree) to support point updates and prefix sums.
Iterate $i$ from $1$ to $N-1$: update the BIT with the value $P_i$, then query the number of elements $\leq i$ in the prefix $P[1..i]$.
Compute $L_i = i - \text{query}(i)$, which is the number of elements in $P[1..i]$ greater than $i$.
Accumulate the total cost as $\sum_{i=1}^{N-1} i \times L_i$.
